system.description: As a reaction, when a hostile creature take an Action, you can spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you gain the effects of the Disengage and Dash actions and can move your full movement in a direction of your choice, if you would make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check before the end of the current turn, you add your superiority die to the result.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
